<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_delde_license.ScannerUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ScannerUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ScannerUtils = Class.create();
ScannerUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {

		/*var month = '3'; //3, 6, 9, 12
		this.CREATED_ON = "sys_created_onONLast " + month + " months@javascript:gs.beginningOfLast"+ month+ "Months()@javascript:gs.endOfLast"+ month + "Months()";
		*/

		var days = "30"; // 60, 90, 120
		this.CREATED_ON="sys_created_onONLast " + days + " days@javascript:gs.beginningOfLast" + days +"Days()@javascript:gs.endOfLast" + days +"Days()^ORDERBYDESCsys_created_on";


    },

	/**
     * Get Subscription role sys ID based on its name
     * @param roleName: String, subscription name
     * @return {sysId}
     */
    getSubRoleSysId: function (roleName) {
        var roleTypeGr = new GlideRecord('license_role_type');
        roleTypeGr.addActiveQuery();
        roleTypeGr.addQuery('name', roleName);
        roleTypeGr.query();
        if (roleTypeGr.hasNext()) {
            roleTypeGr.next();
            return roleTypeGr.getUniqueValue();
        }
    },

    /**
     * Scan Subscription table for new purchases
     * @return {count}
     */
    checkForSubscriptions: function () {
        var subscriptionNamesList = [];
        var subscriptionsGR = new GlideRecord('license_details');
        subscriptionsGR.addEncodedQuery('category!=1');
        subscriptionsGR.query();
        while (subscriptionsGR.next()) {
            if (!this.isLidExisting(subscriptionsGR.getUniqueValue())) {
                var newName = subscriptionsGR.getValue('name').split('-');
                subscriptionNamesList.push({
                    "name": newName[0].trim(),
                    "sysId": subscriptionsGR.getUniqueValue(),
                    "roleType": subscriptionsGR.getValue('measured_role_types'),
                });
            }
        }
        var count = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < subscriptionNamesList.length; i++) {
            this.populateLicenseDefinitions(subscriptionNamesList[i].name, subscriptionNamesList[i].sysId);
            count++;
        }
        return count;
    },

    /**
     * Triggered from BR in Subscription table to create new LID record if new sub is purchased 
     * @param subName: String, subscription name
     * @param subSysId: String, sys id
     * @return {sysId}
     */
    populateLicenseDefinitions: function (subName, subSysId) {
        if (!this.isLidExisting(subSysId)) {
            var newName = subName.split('-');
            var newLidRecord = new GlideRecord('x_delde_license_subscription');
            newLidRecord.initialize();
            newLidRecord.active = false;
            newLidRecord.subscription = subSysId;
            newLidRecord.name = newName.trim();
            var newLidSysId = newLidRecord.insert();

            return newLidSysId;
        }

    },

    /**
     * Process scanning
     * @param rolesArr: Comma separated list of roles
     * @param licenseDefinitionSysId: sys_id
	 * @param subRoleName : license role type of the subscription
     * @return {}
     */
    processScan: function (rolesStr, licenseDefinitionSysId, roleType) {

        var userArr = this.subscribedUsers(rolesStr);

        var uniqueUsersArr = this.removeDuplicates(userArr);
        var nonEcludedUsers = this._nonExcludedUsers(uniqueUsersArr, "admin");

        this.populateLicenseMonitor(nonEcludedUsers, licenseDefinitionSysId, roleType);
    },

    /**
     * Create new records in License Monitor table 
     * @param usersArray:List of Users
     * @param licenseDefinitionSysId: sys_id
     * @return 
     */
    populateLicenseMonitor: function (usersArray, licenseDefinitionSysId, roleType) {
        this._deleteLicenseMonitors(licenseDefinitionSysId); //DELETE OLD RECORDS

        
        var newLimRecords = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < usersArray.length; i++) {
            var newLicenseMonitor = new GlideRecord('x_delde_license_license_monitor');
            newLicenseMonitor.initialize();
            newLicenseMonitor.setValue('subscription', licenseDefinitionSysId);
            newLicenseMonitor.setValue('user', usersArray[i]);
            newLicenseMonitor.setValue('role_type', roleType);
            newLicenseMonitor.setValue('status', 'In progress');
            newLimRecords.push(newLicenseMonitor.insert());
        }
        this.completeScanForLicenseDef(licenseDefinitionSysId);
    },

    /**
     * Change the scan status of the LID after scan process is finished and populate the last scan date
     * @param licenseDefinitionSysId: Sys Id of the LID record
     * @return 
     */

    completeScanForLicenseDef: function (licenseDefinitionSysId) {
        var lidRecordGr = new GlideRecord('x_delde_license_subscription');
        if (lidRecordGr.get(licenseDefinitionSysId)) {
            lidRecordGr.setValue('scan_status', "500");
            lidRecordGr.setValue('last_scanned', new GlideDateTime());
            lidRecordGr.update();
        }
    },

    /**
     * Check if there is License Definition record for the same Subscription
     * @param subscribshionSysId: SysId of the Subscription record
     * @return {boolean}
     */
    isLidExisting: function (subscribshionSysId) {
        var licenseDefinitionGr = new GlideRecord('x_delde_license_subscription');
        licenseDefinitionGr.addQuery('subscription', subscribshionSysId);
        licenseDefinitionGr.query();
        return licenseDefinitionGr.hasNext();
    },

    /**
     * Check if there is License Monitor record for the same user and License Definition
     * @param userSysId: SysId of the user to be checked
     * @param lidRecord: License Definition record SysId to be checked
     * @return {boolean}
     */
    isLimExisting: function (userSysId, lidRecord) {
        var licenseMonitorGr = new GlideRecord('x_delde_license_license_monitor');
        licenseMonitorGr.addQuery('license_definition', lidRecord);
        licenseMonitorGr.addQuery('user', userSysId);
        licenseMonitorGr.query();
        if (licenseMonitorGr.hasNext()) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    },

    /**
     * Clear any Array of duplicates
     * @param arrayWithDuplicates: Comma separated list of users
     * @return {users}
     */
    removeDuplicates: function (arrayWithDuplicates) {
        return arrayWithDuplicates.filter((item,
            index) => arrayWithDuplicates.indexOf(item) === index);
    },

    /**
     * Check if selected users are acting as Fulfilers
     * @param userName: string, name of the user
     * @param tableArr: array, list of tables
     * @param userSysId: sys_id of the user
     * @param subscriptionName: string, name of the subscription
     * @return {actingAs} : string, subscription role type
     */
    isActingAsFulfiller: function (userName, tableArr, userSysId, subscriptionName) { //we need to trigger this from a BR after insert on the LIM table
        try {


			
            var viewedRecords;
            if (subscriptionName.includes("Stakeholder")) {
                viewedRecords = this.userViewedRecord(userSysId, tableArr, subscriptionName);
            } else {
                var actingAs = "";
                var created_on = this.CREATED_ON;//"sys_created_onONLast 3 months@javascript:gs.beginningOfLast3Months()@javascript:gs.endOfLast3Months()"; //created ON last 6 months
                for (var i = 0; i < tableArr.length; i++) {
                    var queryStringAudit = "user=" + userName + "^tablenameIN" + tableArr[i] + "^" + created_on;
                    var sysAuditGr = new GlideRecord('sys_audit');
                    sysAuditGr.addEncodedQuery(queryStringAudit);
                    sysAuditGr.query();
					

                    while (sysAuditGr.next()) {
                        
						if (this._viewedOtherRecord(tableArr[i], sysAuditGr.getValue('documentkey'), userName)) {
                            actingAs = "Fulfiller";
                            return actingAs;
                        } else {
                            continue;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            //Check if the user has viewed other than his records, if yes, return Business Stakeholder, else return Requester
            viewedRecords = this.userViewedRecord(userSysId, tableArr, subscriptionName, userName);
            if (!viewedRecords) {
                actingAs = "Requester";
                return actingAs;
            } else {
                if (subscriptionName == "Legal Service Delivery Premium - Legal User") {
                    actingAs = "Fulfiller";
                    return actingAs;
                }
                actingAs = "Business Stakeholder";
                return actingAs;
            }

        } catch (e) {
            gs.error("isActingAsFulfiller --> " + e);
        }
    },

    /**
     * User viewed others' record i.e. not created by
     * @param userId : sys_id of unique users in array
     * @param tableArr : table name in array
	 * @param subscriptionName : subscripton name
	 * @param userName : user name
     * @return {array||false}
     */
    userViewedRecord: function (userId, tableArr, subscriptionName, userName) {
        try {


            //CHECK IF USER HAS UPDATED ANY APPROVAL RECORD
            if (this._hasUpdatedApproval(userName)) return true;


            var created_on = this.CREATED_ON;//"sys_created_onONLast 3 months@javascript:gs.beginningOfLast3Months()@javascript:gs.endOfLast3Months()"; //created ON last 6 months
            var ui16Qstring = tableArr.join("^ORurlSTARTSWITH"); //eg. incident.do?sys_id=cf71f591db21e450b2e7d3ca4b961968&sysparm_record_target=incident

            var newTableArr = []; //eg. /now/sow/record/incident/d1717591db21e450b2e7d3ca4b9619b0
            for (var i = 0, len = tableArr.length; i < len; i++) {
                newTableArr.push("/" + tableArr[i] + "/");
            }
            var polarisQstring = newTableArr.join("^ORurlLIKE");
            var filterOut = "^urlNOT LIKE_list.do";

            var records = [];

            //Iterate to find if the user has read others record
            var queryString = created_on + "^user=" + userId + "^urlSTARTSWITH" + ui16Qstring + "^ORurlLIKE" + polarisQstring + filterOut;
            var navHistoryGr = new GlideRecord("sys_ui_navigator_history");
            navHistoryGr.addEncodedQuery(queryString);
            navHistoryGr.query();
            while (navHistoryGr.next()) {
                if (subscriptionName == "Legal Service Delivery Premium - Legal User" || subscriptionName == "Integrated Risk Management Professional - IRM Operator") {
                    records.push({
                        "userId": navHistoryGr.getValue("user"),
                        "recordId": recordId,
                        "tableName": tableName,
                        "navigator_history_log": gs.getProperty("glide.servlet.uri") + "sys_ui_navigator_history.do?sys_id=" + navHistoryGr.getUniqueValue()
                    });
                    break;
                }
                var tableName, recordId;
                var urlVal = navHistoryGr.getValue("url");
                if (navHistoryGr.getValue("ui_type") == "polaris") {
                    var s1 = urlVal.split("/now/sow/record/");
                    tableName = s1[1].split("/")[0];
                    recordId = s1[1].split("/")[1];
                } else {
                    recordId = urlVal.slice((urlVal.indexOf('sys_id=') + 7), (urlVal.indexOf('sys_id=') + 39));
                    tableName = urlVal.slice(0, urlVal.indexOf('.do'));
                }

                if (this._viewedOtherRecord(tableName, recordId, navHistoryGr.user.user_name.toString()) == true) {
                    records.push({
                        "userId": navHistoryGr.getValue("user"),
                        "recordId": recordId,
                        "tableName": tableName,
                        "navigator_history_log": gs.getProperty("glide.servlet.uri") + "sys_ui_navigator_history.do?sys_id=" + navHistoryGr.getUniqueValue()
                    });
                    break;
                }
            } //end while				

            return records.length > 0 ? records : false;
        } catch (err) {
            gs.error('Error in function userViewedRecord(): ' + err);
        }

    },

    /**
     * Users who viewed others' record
     * @param tableName
     * @param record_id
     * @param userName
     * @return {boolean}
     */
    _viewedOtherRecord: function (tableName, record_id, userName) {
        if (!gs.tableExists(tableName) && !record_id && !tableName) return;

		
        var tableGr = new GlideRecord(tableName);
        if (tableGr.get(record_id)) {
            if (tableGr.getValue("sys_created_by") != userName)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    },
    /**
     * Users subscribed to license definitions
     * @param associatedRoles: Comma separated roles
     * @param excludeRoles: Comma separated roles
     * @return {null||users}
     */
    subscribedUsers: function (associatedRoles, excludeRoles) {
        if (!associatedRoles) return null;

        var queryString = "role.nameIN" + associatedRoles + "^user.active=true^user.web_service_access_only=false^included_in_roleISEMPTY";

        //GET THE USERS WITH ASSOCIATED ROLES
        var userRoleGa = new GlideAggregate("sys_user_has_role");
        userRoleGa.addNotNullQuery("user");
        userRoleGa.addEncodedQuery(queryString);
        userRoleGa.groupBy("user");
        userRoleGa.query();
        var userArr = [];
        while (userRoleGa.next()) {
            userArr.push(userRoleGa.getValue("user"));
        }

        var uniqueUsers = this.removeDuplicates(userArr);
        var nonExcludedUsers = [];

        //NON ADMIN USERS
        if (excludeRoles) {
            for (var i = 0, len = uniqueUsers.length; i < len; i++) {
                var userHasRoleGr = new GlideRecord("sys_user_has_role");
                userHasRoleGr.addNotNullQuery("user");
                userHasRoleGr.addEncodedQuery("user=" + uniqueUsers[i] + "role.nameIN" + excludeRoles);
                userHasRoleGr.setLimit(1);
                userHasRoleGr.query();
                if (!userHasRoleGr.next())
                    nonExcludedUsers.push(uniqueUsers[i]);
            }

        }

        return (excludeRoles) ? this.removeDuplicates(nonExcludedUsers) : uniqueUsers;
    },

    /**
     * Remove users by roles
     * @param: userArr 
     * @return {null||users}
     */
    _nonExcludedUsers: function (userArr, excludedRoles) {
        var nonExcludedUsers = [];
        for (var i = 0, len = userArr.length; i < len; i++) {
            var userHasRoleGr = new GlideRecord("sys_user_has_role");
            userHasRoleGr.addNotNullQuery("user");
            userHasRoleGr.addEncodedQuery("user=" + userArr[i] + "^role.nameIN" + excludedRoles);
            userHasRoleGr.setLimit(1);
            userHasRoleGr.query();
            if (!userHasRoleGr.next()) {
                nonExcludedUsers.push(userArr[i]);
            }

        }
        return nonExcludedUsers;
    },

    /**
     * Delete license monitor records
     * @param licenseDefSysId : License definitions sys_id
     * @return 
     */

    _deleteLicenseMonitors: function (licenseDefSysId) {
        if (!licenseDefSysId) return;

        var now = new GlideDateTime();
        var s1 = now.getDisplayValueInternal().split(" ");
        var dd = "('" + s1[0] + "','" + s1[1] + "')"; //sys_created_on<javascript:gs.dateGenerate('2024-03-15','11:37:00')

        //Delete old records
        var monitorGr = new GlideRecord("x_delde_license_license_monitor");
        var queryString = "subscription=" + licenseDefSysId + "^sys_created_on<javascript:gs.dateGenerate" + dd;
        monitorGr.addEncodedQuery(queryString);
        monitorGr.query();
        monitorGr.deleteMultiple();
    },

    /**
     * Returns true or false if the user have updated any approval record
     * @param userName : user's user ID
     * @return {boolean}
     */
    _hasUpdatedApproval: function (userName) {
        if (!userName) return false;

        var approverGr = new GlideRecord("sysapproval_approver");
        approverGr.addQuery("sys_updated_by", userName);
        approverGr.setLimit(1);
        approverGr.query();
        return approverGr.hasNext();
    },
